after.example: His sword, the nail, cuts through the fungal wastes with ease.

after.example: The tender grub looks up, waiting to be rescued.

after.example: The ancient glyphs testify to the glory that Hallownest once possessed.
after.exampleZh: 古老的符文证明圣巢曾经拥有的荣耀。

after.exampleZh: 刺客穿过野区从侧翼绕到了敌方后排。

after.exampleZh: 弃掉废牌，去找真正有用的牌。

before.exampleZh: 去打精英吧，遗物值得这份风险。

before.exampleZh: 在做出决定前先算清将要受到的伤害。

after.example: Calculate the incoming damage before you commit.
after.exampleZh: 在做出决定前先算清将要受到的伤害。

before.exampleZh: 先击败最弱的敌人以减少承受的伤害。

after.story: 击败一个，还有下一个在等你，尖塔从不给你喘息的机会。
after.example: Defeat the weakest enemy to reduce incoming damage.
after.exampleZh: 先击败最弱的敌人以减少承受的伤害。

before.exampleZh: 屈伸此刻给你力量，稍后又收回去。

after.example: Flex gives power now and takes it back later.
after.exampleZh: 屈伸此刻给你力量，稍后又收回去。

after.example: Entrench doubles your current block.
after.exampleZh: 掘进会让当前格挡翻倍。

before.story: 冰霜球越多，暴风雪打得越狠。

after.exampleZh: 暴风雪的伤害随冰霜充能球数量增长。

after.example: Dash deals damage and gives block at once.
after.exampleZh: 冲刺同时造成伤害并获得格挡。

after.example: This attack can pierce through enemy block and deal damage directly.

before.story: 祭坛之上，圣物散发微光。
before.example: This sacred relic grants you divine protection during the hardest ascension runs.
before.exampleZh: 这件神圣的遗物在最高进阶难度的挑战中赐予你神圣的庇护。

after.story: 祭坛之上，圣物散发微光，碰它之前你得先想清楚代价是什么。

after.exampleZh: 这件神圣的遗物在最高进阶难度的挑战中赐予你神圣的庇护。

before.story: 献出生命，只为换取一击之力。
before.example: You must sacrifice health to activate the powerful effect of this dark card.
before.exampleZh: 你必须牺牲生命值来激活这张黑暗卡牌的强大效果。

after.story: 献出生命只为换取一击之力，尖塔里最悲壮也最常用的一张牌。
after.example: You must sacrifice health to activate the powerful effect of this dark card.
after.exampleZh: 你必须牺牲生命值来激活这张黑暗卡牌的强大效果。

before.story: 野兽扑来，撕咬凶猛无比。
before.example: The savage beast lunges at you with claws that tear through your armor.
before.exampleZh: 凶猛的野兽扑向你，利爪撕开你的护甲。

after.story: 野兽扑来，撕咬凶猛无比，而你手里只剩最后一张没用上的牌。
after.example: The savage beast lunges at you with claws that tear through your armor.
after.exampleZh: 凶猛的野兽扑向你，利爪撕开你的护甲。

before.story: 挥动巨剑，一击劈开成群小怪。
before.example: Swing your weapon hard to cut through the slimes blocking your path.
before.exampleZh: 用力挥舞你的武器，劈开挡路的史莱姆。

after.story: 挥动巨剑一击劈开成群小怪，清场的快感能让人暂时忘掉血量。
after.example: Swing your weapon hard to cut through the slimes blocking your path.
after.exampleZh: 用力挥舞你的武器，劈开挡路的史莱姆。

before.story: 向前猛刺，直取精英怪的心脏。
before.example: A quick thrust with your dagger pierces the elite's thick armor.
before.exampleZh: 用匕首快速一刺，穿透了精英怪厚重的护甲。

after.story: 向前猛刺，直取精英怪的心脏；基础攻击里最朴素也最可靠的一招。
after.example: A quick thrust with your dagger pierces the elite's thick armor.
after.exampleZh: 用匕首快速一刺，穿透了精英怪厚重的护甲。

before.story: 突破极限，进阶二十也敢硬闯。
before.example: With the right relics, you can transcend your limits and beat Ascension twenty.
before.exampleZh: 有了合适的遗物，你就能超越自身极限，击败进阶二十。

after.story: 突破极限，进阶二十也敢硬闯，哪怕失败的概率从一开始就写在脸上。
after.example: With the right relics, you can transcend your limits and beat Ascension twenty.
after.exampleZh: 有了合适的遗物，你就能超越自身极限，击败进阶二十。

before.story: 真正的防守，从据点外就开始。
before.example: They set traps along the perimeter to catch early rotations.
before.exampleZh: 他们在外围设下陷阱，专门抓敌方前期的转点。

after.story: 真正的防守从据点外就开始，把对手挡在包点之外，比拆包容易得多。
after.example: They set traps along the perimeter to catch early rotations.
after.exampleZh: 他们在外围设下陷阱，专门抓敌方前期的转点。

before.exampleZh: 他在倒计时只剩五秒时开始拆除。
